title: fix(plugin-form): an open edit form's second save sends the version its first save returned (objectui#10565)
body:
Fixes #10565
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`useOccSave` (in `packages/plugin-form/src/occSave.tsx`) now remembers, per object and record, the `updated_at` that its last successful write returned. It sends that version as the next save's `ifMatch` while the form still holds the same read. This covers the guarded save and the **Overwrite** retry alike. Every edit layout (simple, modal, drawer, tabbed, split, wizard) calls this one hook, so all six are covered without touching any call site.

- A `baseRecord` with a different token is a newer read of the record, and its token wins over anything remembered.
- A read without `updated_at` stays unguarded. The change is in which version a guarded save sends, never in whether a save is guarded.
- A write result without a version clears the entry, so the next save falls back to the read's token (the old behaviour).
- ⛔ No new export. ⛔ What the payload carries is unchanged: the dirty-fields rule from PR objectui#10546 stands.
- ⛔ No edit to `ObjectForm.tsx` or to any of the six `baseRecord` call sites, so no overlap with open PR objectui#10620.

## Measurement first: the defect, against the real enforcement

Enforcement point: `updateData` in objectstack's `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (`assertVersionOf`, which compares instants). REST maps it to `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE`. objectui's adapter forwards `ifMatch` as an `If-Match` header through `@objectstack/client`.

Rig: objectstack `origin/main` at `949e99bed9` in a scratch worktree. The dependency closure was built, then one app object was booted with `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack`: the real kernel, the ObjectQL engine, the sqlite-wasm driver, REST, Hono, auth and security. It was exposed on a loopback HTTP listener. The objectui side used the real `ObjectStackAdapter` (`@objectstack/client` 17.4.0) over real HTTP. No mock enforced anything. Nothing from the rig is committed.

Before the fix (objectui base `e0f820246`):

- Raw HTTP: a read gave `updated_at` = V0. PATCH with `If-Match: V0` answered 200, and the saved record it returned carried a newer `updated_at` (V1). A second PATCH with the same `If-Match: V0` answered **409** `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` with `currentVersion` = V1 ("Record occm_device/ID was modified by another user (current version V1, expected V0)"). Control: PATCH with `If-Match: V1` answered 200.
- Real `useOccSave` over the real adapter: the first save landed and its result carried V1. The second save from the same `baseRecord` sent V0, was refused 409, and **opened the conflict dialog** against the user's own save.
- A mounted `ObjectForm` in edit mode with the real adapter: after two submits, the second sent the first read's token, got **409, and the dialog opened**.

⇒ The first write's response does carry the new version, so the fix takes it from there. No refetch after save is needed.

After the fix, on the same rig: the second hook save sent V1 and landed, with no dialog. The mounted `ObjectForm`'s second submit sent the first write's version and landed, with no dialog. When another writer changed the record between the two saves, the second save still answered **409** and opened the dialog, so the guard is still live.

## Pins

New `packages/plugin-form/src/occSave.secondSave.test.tsx`, beside the existing OCC suites. It has 9 hook rows and 1 `ObjectForm` row. The data source double is shaped from the measurement:

- no token means no check, and a token naming another instant earns a 409;
- each accepted write stamps a strictly later ISO-Z `updated_at` and returns the whole record;
- a refusal carries the measured 409 body. That body is built into an `Error` the way `@objectstack/client` builds one, then passed through the adapter's real `normaliseClientError`.

The rows: single-save control · second save sends the first write's version · third save sends the second's · another writer still earns the dialog · after **Overwrite** the next save sends the overwrite's version · a newer read wins · per-record keying · an unguarded read stays unguarded · a result without a version falls back to the read · two submits from one mounted `ObjectForm`.

Ablation (the remembered-token read removed, `versionToSend` returning the read's token), at head `7e1e06d0f`, through `ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor hit 1 to 0, the marker 0 to 1, and the blob moved from `f0d66a02` to `02c4b75a`). Over the three OCC suites: **5 failed | 16 passed (21)**. Red: the second save, third save, another-writer, after-Overwrite and `ObjectForm` rows. Green: the single-save control, the four other new rows, and all 11 existing OCC rows. Restore was proven by blob: `f0d66a02` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the marker count is 0.

## Gates (at `7e1e06d0f`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/` (repo root): **Test Files 122 passed (122) · Tests 1309 passed | 1 skipped (1310)**.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check` (the script name echoed; the closure was built first with `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' run build`): exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new test file.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` OK · `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new · `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: 1 changeset for 1 released package · `check-changeset-no-major` OK · `check-changeset-overwrite`: reports the one deliberate edit below.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: the self-contradiction reading is clean. It asked for a re-read of `.changeset/6237-wizard-step-config-split.md`, because that file names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx`. I read that paragraph: it is about the section-predicate support table and is still true.
- ESLint over the two touched source files, with `--no-inline-config`, per rule, head against base. `occSave.tsx`: 3 `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` warnings at both head and base, unchanged, and 0 `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` at both. The new test file: 0 findings. `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` is on (warn) for these files, and the config is not type-aware, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED (6 paths).

## File surface: beyond the claim, and why

The claim declared `occSave.tsx`, the pins and one changeset. This change also edits three prose files, because it made a sentence in each of them false:

- `packages/plugin-form/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` said an edit save carries the `updated_at` the form read. Both now say what a save sends once the open form has already saved.
- `.changeset/10156-edit-form-writes-only-changed-fields.md` (pending, so it publishes verbatim in the same release) said "The update still carries `ifMatch` = the `updated_at` the form read". One clause names the objectui#10565 behaviour. It is a prose-only change, and its front matter is untouched.

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, not filed: two saves in flight at once (a double submit before the first resolves) still read the same token, so the later one can meet a 409. That was true before this change and was not measured.
- Observation, not filed: booting objectstack's `bootStack` logs `Port 0 is in use, using port N instead` from the Hono server plugin. It is a log line only. Carrier: none.
